The evidence also reveals Russian activities as the catalyst of recent military developments, and that confrontational behaviour in the military dimension pits Russia against the other seven Arctic countries. In this regard, further research as to if and under what conditions the Arctic could be a future sphere of new Russian military activities would be valuable. Russian interests in the Arctic, its military developments after 2014, and the actual reasons for these activities are key topics for further debate.
